name: Sunray Cayenne 4-Person Infrared Outdoor Sauna 400D3
description: Description Enjoy the ultimate outdoor wellness experience with the Cayenne 4-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna. Designed for year-round durability, it features a sealed weatherproof cabin and stylish metal composite roof to withstand the elements. Ten rapid ceramic heaters deliver soothing infrared warmth, heating up quickly to a relaxing 140°F. Crafted from natural Canadian hemlock wood, the Cayenne sauna combines functionality and comfort with wide bench seating, recessed lighting, Bluetooth audio, and an oxygen ionization system for fresh, clean air. Easy to assemble and built to last, it's your backyard retreat for daily rejuvenation. Features Sealed, weatherproof cabin ideal for outdoor use Ten rapid heat ceramic heaters for efficient infrared warmth Durable natural Canadian hemlock wood construction Wide bench seating for enhanced comfort Low EMF emission Exterior digital control panel for easy adjustments Recessed interior lighting and Bluetooth speaker system Ozone sterilization and oxygen ionization system for purified air ETL/CSA Certified for safety and reliability What's Included?
